title: calandrinia alba
intro: Calandrinia alba, commonly known as White Purslane, is a perennial plant species native to the Andes mountain range in South America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Calandrinia alba include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
